topic: K-Stick and the Pencil That Draws Back
hook_text: K-Stick just wanted to draw one tiny smile...
background: Simple reusable desk scene with a white sheet of paper and a small cup of pencils
main_expression: Excited smile changing to wide-eyed confusion, then proud surprise
main_pose: Leaning over the desk while holding a pencil, then quickly hiding behind the paper
prop: Yellow pencil and white sheet of paper
scene_1: K-Stick sits at the desk and proudly draws a tiny smiley face on the paper.
scene_2: The pencil suddenly moves by itself and draws a giant silly mustache on K-Stick's face.
scene_3: K-Stick drops the pencil and points at it, but the pencil draws a tiny speech bubble saying, "Your turn!"
twist_ending: K-Stick confidently grabs the pencil and draws a mustache on the pencil instead; the pencil immediately draws a tiny cap on itself, making K-Stick gasp and laugh.
